# RLMesh library

Unpack an RLMesh C/C++ release package here, so this folder holds `include/`, `lib/` and, on Windows, `bin/`:

- Windows: `rlmesh-<version>-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.tar.gz`
- Linux: `rlmesh-<version>-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz`

Both are attached to each [RLMesh release](https://github.com/ArenaX-Labs/rlmesh/releases). Strip the archive's top-level folder, for example `tar -xzf rlmesh-<version>-<platform>.tar.gz --strip-components=1`.
